entities.name: Martin Frobenius Ledermüller
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martin Frobenius Ledermüller was a German jurist, naturalist, microscopist, and illustrator. Known for his work in microscopy and natural history illustration, he contributed significantly to the Enlightenment-era understanding of the natural world.
